name: 10111 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10111 (New York) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (13%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 10111 (New York) has 14 organizations listing opportunities online, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.
